scripts.check: lake build && lake test && .lake/build/bin/docgen schema | npx prettier@3 --stdin-filepath schema.json | diff docs/spec.schema.json - && .lake/build/bin/docgen markdown | npx prettier@3 --stdin-filepath spec-format.md | diff docs/spec-format.md -
scripts.docs: .lake/build/bin/docgen schema | npx prettier@3 --stdin-filepath schema.json > docs/spec.schema.json && .lake/build/bin/docgen markdown | npx prettier@3 --stdin-filepath spec-format.md > docs/spec-format.md
